subject: C2 landed (6c78f22); Modal smoke needs your OK
body: @nathan-c, all five assignments are in code on main (9c8b80d, 6c78f22). (1) models-config DONE: configs/models.json has your exact lineup (dev openai-compat:Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B; held-out anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5+thinking, openai:gpt-5+thinking; J1 anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5; J2 openai:gpt-5.1; generator claude-cli:sonnet). The checks reuse your measure.model_family: held-out judge vs generator family, a cross-family headline judge per held-out target, no claude-cli targets. python3 -m autoresearch.research.models_config prints the flags. (2) modal-vllm-target CODE DONE, NOT DEPLOYED: harness/modal_vllm.py (vLLM 0.10.1.1, --reasoning-parser qwen3, hermes tool calls, 1x H100, scales to zero after 15 min). Served id Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B. Base URL convention: OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL=https://<workspace>--autoresearch-vllm-serve.modal.run/v1, OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY = the vllm-key Modal secret (MODAL_BASE_URL/MODAL_API_KEY = same values for Inspect). Cost: billed per GPU-second, not per token: about $4/h for one H100 at Modal list price (check modal.com/pricing). Smoke estimate: about 30 GPU-minutes including the first weights download, so about $2, plus about 15 Haiku judge calls (under $0.10). APPROVAL REQUESTED for: modal secret create vllm-key VLLM_API_KEY=<random>; modal deploy harness/modal_vllm.py; python3 scripts/c2_smoke_target.py --n 5 (writes results/smoke/c2_target_<date>.json). (3) petri-harness and petri-measurer DONE: AuditResult JSONL, your judges (A2 probes, A1/validity audit, per-judge A1/A2), Petri scores apart in petri_scores. The Petri target is mapped from --target, so it is the model that answers the probes. (4) modal-sandbox-tools CODE DONE: the target's shell calls get real Modal Sandbox output (verified through Petri with mock models and a fake sandbox, not yet against Modal). (5) api-target claimed: every target in the config is an API backend, and the config check refuses claude-cli targets. I did not touch llm.py. eval/ ANSWER: folded. eval/pipeline is removed; audits go through harness/petri, scoring through PetriMeasurer, and the condition comparison through scripts/c2_e3b.py (paired by seed, with CIs). eval/README.md maps old to new, so E3b has one scorer. Open: per-GPU-second cost in OpenAICompatLLM (your llm.py, so the spend cap can stop vLLM), Petri v1 seeds, and the Petri faithfulness pair. Status is in PLAN 16.2.
